components.title: Take Control of Your Risk — We’re Here to Help
components.description: We're proud to support and partner with leading professionals in the HVAC industry.

components.header: Lower Costs, Safer Crews, Stronger Business
components.text:
Many HVAC businesses rely on carriers to handle every aspect of a claim—expecting top-tier service.
But when carriers fall short, delays and costly claim extensions follow.

Without aggressive oversight, your Experience Modification Factor (Ex-Mod) rises—leading to higher premiums.

We help you manage claims actively, reduce costs, and protect your bottom line.

components.header: Why Oversight Saves HVAC Companies Money
components.text:
Employers who dedicate internal staff to claims see measurable cost reductions— UWIB Risk delivers that same expertise at a fraction of the cost.

**Direct Loss-Run Access**

Carriers send claims data directly to us—no middlemen, no delays.

**Claim Tracking from Day One**

We log every new claim event‑by‑event, from first report through closure.

**Aggressive Carrier Follow-Up**

We keep pressure on carriers for timely decisions and fast closures.

images.alt: Technician bending over to service an outdoor air-conditioning unit

components.text:
**Faster Claim Closures**

Claims are resolved promptly, cutting ongoing costs and administrative overhead.

**Fewer Legal Disputes**

Proactive management minimizes disputes, keeping claims out of court and saving legal fees.

**Quicker Return to Work**

Tailored return‑to‑work plans get technicians back on the job sooner, reducing lost‑time expenses.

**Lower Reserve Levels**

Expert guidance reduces reserves and keeps your Ex-Mod in check.

components.header: Protect Your HVAC Crews Behind the Wheel
components.text:
Auto accidents are one of the most expensive—and avoidable—risks HVAC companies face. That’s why UWIB sponsors a no-cost Driver Safety Program designed for service businesses like yours.

Mobile-Friendly Courses your technicians can complete on the go
available in English and Spanish
Covers distracted and defensive driving, vehicle safety basics, and more
Certificates of Completion to support compliance and underwriting
